report: Revision Kohn-Sham reference solver (independent Python, staggered finite differences + Richardson): self-checks

checks.name: theory_input_coefficients
checks.detail: ks-theory.json (sha256 34f7fa2a4543fd91): M_eff = m + 15/16 lambda S, v_v = -1/16 lambda n, e_int = lambda[15/32 S^2 + -1/32 n^2] (Hartree 1/2 plus the uniform-gas exchange -1/32, -1/32); consistent: M_eff - m = d e_int/dS (15/16 = 15/16), v_v = d e_int/dn (-1/16 = -1/16): True; exact-Fock variant (exchange.exactFockSlab): e_x^exact = -lambda 1/32 (n^2 + S^2 - Q^2), i.e. e_int + lambda 1/32 Q^2 (stated: 1/32) and w_Q = lambda 1/16 Q sigma3 = d(lambda 1/32 Q^2)/dQ, the n^2 and S^2 coefficients equal the uniform-gas -1/32, -1/32: True
